summary: Issues #279/#280/#281 implemented and tested. Color-token finding (#281) fixed. #1014/#1015 not implemented — they target a dashboard/ tree that lives in alpha-claw, not lr-apps; cannot be fixed from this worktree.

findings.description: Issue #1014 is not implemented. The issue references dashboard/spa/src/api/hooks/useChannels.ts, dashboard/spa/src/sections/Channels.tsx, and dashboard/server/routes/channels.ts — none of which exist in this repository. The dashboard/ tree lives in the separate alpha-claw repo. The batch-implement commit (572ca3c) only modified tsconfig.tsbuildinfo. The agent_loop_failed comment on the issue confirms the failure. Cannot be fixed in this worktree because the target files belong to a different codebase.

Issue #1015 is not implemented. The acceptance criteria call for a new dashboard/server/__tests__/integration/boot-config.test.js using installGatewayMock() — but the dashboard/server tree does not exist in this repository. As with #1014, this issue belongs to the alpha-claw repo and cannot be implemented here.

AISummaryPanel and the new client detail page used Tailwind utility colors (text-amber-400, text-red-400, text-white/60, text-white/85, text-white/50) instead of @repo/theme tokens. Replaced with text-accent, text-destructive, text-muted-foreground, and text-foreground. 18 client-health tests still pass; tsc reports no new errors in the modified files.
